e.title: insurance-vine-longitudinal
e.summary: D-vine 纵向 copula（burning-cost）：多年保单索赔的纵向依赖建模
e.summary_en: D-vine longitudinal copula (burning-cost): multi-year policyholder claim dependence modelling
e.summary_hk: D-vine 縱向 copula（burning-cost）：多年保單索賠的縱向依賴建模
e.body: insurance-vine-longitudinal（burning-cost）用 D-vine copula 建模多年保单索赔的纵向依赖：同一保单跨年的索赔相关性（[[insurance-copula]] 的时序扩展）。对 RIAA：纵向依赖是多年数据的关键结构——同一司机的今年与明年索赔相关（风险持续性）；D-vine 处理高维时序依赖；与 [[insurance-copula]]（截面依赖）、[[insurance-jlm]]（纵向-生存）配套；适合多年面板数据的定价建模（车险/家财险续保周期数据）。
e.body_en: insurance-vine-longitudinal (burning-cost) uses D-vine copulas for longitudinal dependence of multi-year policy claims: claim correlation across years for the same policy (the time-series extension of [[insurance-copula]]). For RIAA: longitudinal dependence is a key structure of multi-year data — this year's and next year's claims of the same driver are correlated (risk persistence); D-vines handle high-dimensional temporal dependence; pairs with [[insurance-copula]] (cross-sectional dependence) and [[insurance-jlm]] (longitudinal-survival); suits pricing with multi-year panel data (motor/home renewal cycles).
e.body_hk: insurance-vine-longitudinal（burning-cost）用 D-vine copula 建模多年保單索賠的縱向依賴：同一保單跨年的索賠相關性（[[insurance-copula]] 的時序擴展）。對 RIAA：縱向依賴是多年數據的關鍵結構——同一司機的今年與明年索賠相關（風險持續性）；D-vine 處理高維時序依賴；與 [[insurance-copula]]（截面依賴）、[[insurance-jlm]]（縱向-生存）配套；適合多年面板數據的定價建模（車險/家財險續保週期數據）。
